cohort: Pregnant women with COVID-19 admitted to the adult critical care unit at a specialized tertiary hospital in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
finding: The APACHI IV scores accurately predicted patient's mortality, duration of MV, and length of ICU stay.
mod_finding: Patients treated with high-flow nasal cannula (HFNC) were mostly discharged or delivered normally, while the mechanical ventilation (MV) and extracorporeal membrane oxygenation groups mostly underwent C-sections.
